name: chatwoot
description: Reads Chatwoot account data and safely plans typed reverse ETL mutations across the official application and platform APIs. Public client/no-auth operations are recorded as planned until a separate safe contract exists.

risk.read: external Chatwoot API reads of account-scoped conversation, contact, inbox, label, team, agent, and message data; additional official reads are ledgered as planned until typed stream/direct-read fixtures exist
risk.write: 73 named Chatwoot reverse ETL actions; DELETE/destructive/admin actions require typed destructive confirmation plus plan, preview, approval, execute
risk.approval: reverse ETL mutations require plan -> preview -> explicit approval token -> execute; destructive/admin actions additionally require --confirm destructive
